## Document Generation Checklist

- [ ] Validation script passed (`python3 _Tools/validate_doc.py <file>`)
- [ ] Generated document opened and reviewed in Word — not just validator passing
- [ ] CTN verified in document header/title page
- [ ] No placeholder text remaining in document
- [ ] Revision history row added with correct version, date, and editor
- [ ] File saved to correct `Drafts/` folder with correct naming convention
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main` before merging
